description: This source file implements an HTTP middleware for audit logging in a FastAPI application. It captures details about incoming requests and responses, and persists audit logs asynchronously to a database.

classes.name: AuditLoggingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that logs each HTTP request and response for audit purposes, including request metadata and timing.

methods.name: Optional[str] _safe_user_agent(user_agent: Optional[str])
methods.description: Sanitizes the User-Agent string by truncating it to prevent log injection and excessively large entries.

methods.description: Handles the HTTP request, logs relevant details asynchronously, and manages the response lifecycle.
